vocabulary.meaning_en: what is right or probable; also used for advice
what you think will or should happen
vocabulary.example: My expectation is that the bus will come soon.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a reason you give for not doing something
vocabulary.example: He always has an excuse for being late.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something you should or must do
vocabulary.example: Helping your family is an obligation.

vocabulary.meaning_en: able to happen, but not sure
vocabulary.example: It's possible that he is busy.

vocabulary.meaning_en: likely to happen; more sure than possible
depending on who looks at it or compares it
vocabulary.example: Young and old are relative: 40 is young if you are 60.

vocabulary.meaning_en: your way of seeing or thinking about something
vocabulary.example: From my perspective, the plan is good.

vocabulary.meaning_en: clear and definite; you can believe it
vocabulary.note_en: Also a noun: hard building material.
vocabulary.example: Give me a concrete time, not "later".

vocabulary.meaning_en: extra time after the normal time (in a game or at work)
an opinion about what someone should do
vocabulary.note_ar: غير معدودة: some advice (ليس an advice)
vocabulary.example: My father gave me good advice.

fine_lines.title: could be vs should be
fine_lines.explanation_ar: could be = ممكن فقط، وهناك احتمالات كثيرة (لسنا متأكدين). should be = مُرجَّح وصحيح، ونصدّقه أكثر، وغالبًا مع وقت محدد. تذكّر: should فيها "اثنان" أي أكثر تأكيدًا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: could be = only possible; many things could happen, we are not sure. should be = probable and right; we believe it more, often with a specific time. Should is more sure than could.

examples.sentence: The doctor should be with you in five minutes. (Relax, it's probably five minutes.)
The doctor could be with you in five minutes. (Maybe five, maybe an hour.)

fine_lines.title: possible vs probable
fine_lines.explanation_ar: possible = يمكن أن يحدث. probable = من المرجّح أن يحدث (أقوى).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Possible = it can happen. Probable = it will likely happen (stronger).

examples.sentence: It's possible that we will win.
It's probable that the train will be on time.

expressions.phrase: It should be ready in five minutes.
expressions.meaning_ar: من المفترض أن يكون جاهزًا خلال خمس دقائق.
expressions.meaning_en: It will probably be ready in five minutes.
expressions.example: Your food should be ready in five minutes.

expressions.phrase: It could be over at any moment.
expressions.meaning_en: It's possible that it ends at any time.
expressions.example: The game is in overtime. It could be over at any moment.

expressions.meaning_en: A polite way to say: I need to leave.
expressions.example: It's late. I should be going.

expressions.meaning_en: when you compare it with other things
expressions.example: Relatively speaking, this phone is cheap.

grammar.title: Modal + be
grammar.explanation_ar: التركيب: الفاعل + should/could + be + (صفة / اسم / فعل -ing / مكان). فعل be يعبّر عمّا نؤمن أنه صحيح من وجهة نظرنا، والفعل الناقص يغيّر قوة هذا الاعتقاد.
grammar.explanation_en: Structure: subject + should/could + be + (adjective / noun / -ing verb / place). Be shows what we believe is true from our point of view; the modal changes how strong that belief is.
examples: You should be a better student if you study harder.

grammar.title: Should be = probable and right
grammar.explanation_ar: استخدم should be عندما تظن أن هذا هو الصحيح أو الأرجح، خاصة مع وقت محدد. السامع يطمئن ويصدّق.
grammar.explanation_en: Use should be when you think this is the right or most likely result, especially with a specific time. The listener relaxes and believes it.
examples: The bus should be here at 8:15.
Mom: Dinner should be ready in five minutes.

grammar.title: Could be = only possible
grammar.explanation_ar: استخدم could be عندما تكون هناك احتمالات كثيرة ولست متأكدًا أيها سيحدث.
grammar.explanation_en: Use could be when many things can happen and you are not sure which one will.
examples: The game could be over at any moment.
He could be sick, or he could be busy. I don't know.

grammar.title: Should for advice
grammar.explanation_ar: should + المصدر تُستخدم أيضًا لإعطاء النصيحة: You should go to school.
grammar.explanation_en: should + base verb is also used to give advice: You should go to school.
examples: You should go to bed early.
You should study for the test.

questions.question: Which is more sure?
questions.explanation_ar: should be تعني مُرجَّح وأكثر تأكيدًا.
questions.explanation_en: Should be means probable, more sure.

questions.question: The nurse says: "The doctor ___ with you in five minutes." You can relax.
questions.explanation_ar: should be + وقت محدد: نصدّقه ونطمئن.
questions.explanation_en: Should be + a specific time: we believe it and relax.

questions.question: The game is in overtime. Nobody knows when a goal will come. It ___ over at any moment.
questions.explanation_en: Many things can happen: could be.

questions.question: "Relative" truth means ___.
choices: it depends on who is looking
questions.explanation_en: Relative = it depends on your point of view.

questions.question: What is "overtime"?
choices: extra time after the normal time
questions.explanation_en: Overtime is extra time after the normal time.

questions.question: "I should be going." means ___.
choices: I am going now for sure
questions.explanation_ar: طريقة مهذبة لقول: عليّ أن أغادر.
questions.explanation_en: A polite way to say: I need to leave.
